name: 저승 판관
outfit: 화려한 금색 자수가 놓인 붉은색 관복과 긴 망토
silhouette: 머리의 높은 관모, 휘날리는 긴 망토, 거대한 붓의 실루엣, 허리 뒤로 튀어나온 두루마리
signature_motion: 붓을 허공에 휘둘러 글자를 새기는 동작
signature_vfx: 붓 끝에서 뿜어져 나오는 밝은 금색 영적 글자와 흩날리는 붉은 꽃잎
unique_features: 허리 뒤에 떠 있는 명부 두락
visual_en: A 3-head tall figure wearing a brilliant crimson official robe with heavy golden embroidery. On the head, a tall black traditional Korean hat (Gwanmo) with golden ornaments stands out. The eyes glow with a piercing, radiant golden light. The character holds a massive, glowing calligraphy brush that emits bright white ink particles. Floating behind the waist is a large, ancient scroll (Myeongbu) partially unfurled. A long, flowing crimson cape with golden edges drifts upwards, accompanied by a strong, radiant golden aura. The skin is deathly pale white, contrasting sharply with the deep red and bright gold elements.
pose_en: Standing tall and imposing, holding the brush ready to strike the air.
vfx_en: A few bold red ink brush strokes slashing through the air in front of it and small red sparks
motion_en: Swiping the brush to summon ghostly spirits
lore: 저승길 중간보스. 사라졌다가 플레이어 곁에 나타나 따라오는 탄 세 발을 쏘고, 망혼을 불러낸다(시울처럼).

anim_notes.ultimate: summoning small white wandering spirits around it
anim_notes.entrance: appearing out of a swirl of dark mist

concept: 저승길 — 한국 저승 설화(저승차사 · 옥졸 · 삼도천 · 명부 · 염라). 무섭되 이 게임의 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.

body_plan.body: A small, humanoid character wearing a large black hat and a flowing red robe with gold patterns.

frame_notes.entrance_0: Only a few thin dark crimson ink brush strokes near its brush and feet; most of the picture around the character stays empty and dark, the red robe clearly visible
frame_notes.entrance_1: Only a few thin dark crimson ink brush strokes near its brush and feet; most of the picture around the character stays empty and dark, the red robe clearly visible
frame_notes.ultimate_2: Only a few thin dark crimson ink brush strokes near its brush and feet; most of the picture around the character stays empty and dark, the red robe clearly visible

vfx_en_old: Bright golden calligraphy characters and glowing red particles swirling around the brush.

frame_text.entrance_0: stepping into view with a few small sparks at its feet, its whole body solid and clearly drawn
frame_text.entrance_1: landing dramatically, anything loose on its body (cloth, hair, fur) still flowing, a few small sparks at its feet
frame_text.ultimate_2: at the peak of its ultimate ability, a bold effect in front of it and small sparks around it
